semantics.noCollapseRule: Do not sum accrued entitlement + realised cash flow + embedded income + reference productivity into one income number without explicit non-overlap reconciliation.
semantics.claimableStateRule: Current claimable balances and their deltas are state observations, not period-income or realised-cash-flow authority.
semantics.claimableShardRule: Same-mechanism claimable rows may be aggregated as state only; if any shard lacks a numeric amount or USD value, that aggregate field remains UNKNOWN rather than treating the shard as zero.
semantics.continuityRule: Claims, reinvestment, transfers, source disappearance and protocol resets do not erase previously admitted income events. Ambiguous decreases become local reconciliation-needed states.
